elements.text:
You've agreed with your friends to play a game online together. When you log in you can see that no one is online. Why isn't anyone online yet? 
 
They really want to play the game online with me; they will come online within a few minutes. 

On a scale of 1-5, how likely is this thought to pop into your mind?

buttons: 0::1 - Doesn't pop up in my mind
1::2 - Unlikley to pop up in my mind
2::3 - Might pop up in my mind
3::4 - Likley to pop up in my mind
4::5 - Definitely pops up in my mind
elements.name: 5A
